hibernate-mapping.sql-query: SELECT dbo.Users.user_id AS ID, dbo.Users.username AS Username, dbo.Users.user_critical AS Critical, dbo.Users.active_user AS Active, dbo.Users_Passwords.d_last_change AS LastChange, dbo.Communication_Devices.cm_dv_name AS CDName, dbo.Communication_Devices.cm_dv_ip AS IP, dbo.Communication_Device_Types.cm_dv_type_name AS CDType FROM dbo.Users INNER JOIN dbo.Users_Passwords ON dbo.Users.user_password_id = dbo.Users_Passwords.user_password_id INNER JOIN dbo.Communication_Device_Users ON dbo.Users.user_id = dbo.Communication_Device_Users.user_id INNER JOIN dbo.Communication_Devices ON dbo.Communication_Device_Users.cm_dv_id = dbo.Communication_Devices.cm_dv_id INNER JOIN dbo.Communication_Device_Types ON dbo.Communication_Devices.cm_dv_type_id = dbo.Communication_Device_Types.cm_dv_type_id WHERE (:critico = -1 OR dbo.Users.user_critical = :critico) AND (:estadoUsuario = -1 OR dbo.Users.active_user = :estadoUsuario) AND (:tipo = -1 OR dbo.Communication_Device_Types.cm_dv_type_id = :tipo) AND (:nombre IS NULL OR upper(dbo.Communication_Devices.cm_dv_name) LIKE :nombre)
